[P2] Align companion release pins with the built artifacts

The testing and telemetry exporter packages still derive their versions from unchanged `__about__.py` values `1.3.0` and `0.0.1`. The publishing workflow builds those files directly, so releasing this revision will not produce the `1.4.0` and `0.0.2` artifacts specified here and in the installation guidance. Include the corresponding companion version bumps, or align the table, installation command, and helper-version references with compatible release artifacts.
